name: e2e_v15
description: Large long-term-memory gate for a 王者荣耀 companion bot: 18 distinct ordinary Chinese players (ages 15-66, different jobs, cities, family situations and speaking styles incl. dialect and internet slang), 10-11 sessions each over 2025-11..2026-11. Ranks, main heroes, phones, jobs, homes, relatives' jobs/schools, hobbies, pets and plans change over time (some more than once); the assistant makes 2+ concrete promises per player in varied wording. Per player 16 questions: 5 facts (>=2 about other people, >=1 mentioned only in passing), 3 updates (current value; stale_any = all outdated values), 3 trajectories (ordered answer_all, 3-5 states, game and non-game), 2 assistant promises (answer_any = promise key said in an assistant line), 3 negatives (promise never made, unstated attribute of a mentioned person, topic never discussed). dev=v15_d1,v15_d2; test=v15_t1..v15_t16, written blind to the system under test.
